// Fixture-only: create duplicate legacy rows to exercise bounded cleanup.
export const fixtureSeed = mutation({ args: {userId:v.string(), count:v.number()}, returns:v.null(), handler: async(ctx,{userId,count}) => { for (let i=0;i<count;i++) await ctx.db.insert("passwords",{userId,passwordHashPHC:"fixture"}); return null; } });
